title: Unique lifting of a completed morphism between torsion-controlled arrows
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme, J a quasi-coherent ideal and H,F,F' coherent modules [pqf-def-locnoeth], [pqf-def-coherent], [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Let a:F\to H and a':F'\to H each have actual coherent kernel and cokernel annihilated by a positive power of J (the exponents may differ). If theta:\widehat F_J\to\widehat F'_J satisfies \widehat a'_J\circ theta=\widehat a_J, there exists exactly one coherent-module morphism g:F\to F' such that a'\circ g=a and \widehat g_J=theta. No invertibility assumption on theta or g is imposed.

proof.text: On each affine identify coherent sheaves with finite modules and formal completions with tensor product over A with S = the I-adic completion. The map A to S is flat and induces an isomorphism modulo I.

Localizing at any generator f_i of I kills both actual kernels and cokernels, so a and a' become invertible. Define the localized comparison by a followed by the inverse of a'. The given completed map theta commutes with the arrows to H, so it agrees with these comparisons on completed localizations. The localized maps agree on double localizations.

For every element x of the source its prescribed completed and localized images form a kernel element of the gluing-complex differential for the target. Exactness produces an element of the target. Injectivity gives uniqueness, linearity, the arrow equation and the completion equation. Thus there is exactly one affine comparison map.

Transfer the affine maps by tilde. On intersections use affine refinements and the affine uniqueness just proved. Glue these maps on the affine cover; both equations and equality of maps are checked locally. This works for the zero and unit ideals and for the empty scheme.

lean.statement:
theorem torsionControlled_completion_hom_lift
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (H F F' : CoherentModules X) (a : F ⟶ H) (a' : F' ⟶ H)
    (ha : (∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
        (kernel a.hom)) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
        (cokernel a.hom))))
    (ha' : (∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
        (kernel a'.hom)) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
        (cokernel a'.hom))))
    (θ : (completion X J).obj F ⟶ (completion X J).obj F')
    (hθ : θ ≫ (completion X J).map a' = (completion X J).map a) :
    ∃! g : F ⟶ F', g ≫ a' = a ∧ (completion X J).map g = θ
